sbp_change_wk8.poolable_reason: TWO TRIALS RANDOMISE THE SAME FIXED-DOSE COMBINATION AGAINST THE SAME COMPARATOR AND REGISTER THE SAME CONTINUOUS ENDPOINT. Nothing had to be harmonised: this review's question was already a question, its estimand was already shared, and its arms already matched. WHAT IT LACKED WAS ANY EVIDENCE THAT THESE WERE THE ONLY TWO, and the executed search of 2026-08-19 supplies it -- 57 registrations screened, 53 excluded, and only FOUR carrying both arms of the contrast at all. The other two are long-term open-label SAFETY studies that register no blood-pressure change outcome at any rank, so they are ELIGIBLE AND NOT POOLABLE rather than absent.
sbp_change_wk8.small_k_interval_note: Handbook 6.5 sections 10.10.4.4-10.10.4.5: with two or three studies a sensitivity comparison of interval methods is advised. Hartung-Knapp is not adopted as the primary interval here; the corpus rule is that it is reported as a sensitivity analysis at k<=3.
sbp_change_wk8.what_this_does_not_establish: NOT that the trials are free of bias -- no RoB-2 assessment is recorded on this object. NOT that the pooled value transfers outside the populations these trials enrolled. NOT that the registry's posted analysis is itself correct: it is READ, and reading it faithfully is a different claim from endorsing it.

sbp_change_wk8.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. It was never a judgement that the pool was sound, and the renderer read it as permission to assert 'pooled on the X scale'. RENAMED to source_page_pooled, which is what it says. `poolable` is retained so nothing breaks, and it is DEPRECATED: read source_page_pooled for what the source did, and estimand_established for whether the pool is defensible. A PAGE SHOULD DISPLAY A POOLED ESTIMATE BECAUSE ITS ESTIMAND WAS ESTABLISHED, NOT BECAUSE SOMEONE ONCE POOLED IT.
sbp_change_wk8.estimand_established_means: TRUE only where every contributing trial has been READ and shown to measure the same quantity, or the same construct with a variance stated. FALSE where that was checked and failed. NULL where it was never checked -- AN ABSENT ASSERTION AND A NEGATIVE ONE ARE DIFFERENT STATES and null is not a pass.

sbp_change_wk8.estimand_established_does_not_cover_the_: READ THIS BESIDE `estimand_established`. That flag records that every contributing trial measures the SAME QUANTITY. It records NOTHING about what that quantity was measured AGAINST -- whether the comparators are of one kind, whether each comparison was randomised, whether it was concurrent. On attr-pn-review the flag is TRUE and correct while the pool combines patisiran against its own saline placebo, vutrisiran against PATISIRAN, and eplontersen against the placebo cohort of a DIFFERENT TRIAL. The two questions were never separated. Named as P48 in PAGE-STANDARD.md v1.21.0 and swept by scripts/audit_mixed_contrast_pools.py.

POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_21.a_the_two_trials_do_not_measure_at_the_s: READ THIS BESIDE THE ESTIMATE. This pooled outcome is identified as WEEK 8. NCT00846365 registers its primary at week 8; NCT01033071 REGISTERS ITS PRIMARY AT WEEK 12 -- 'Change From Baseline in Trough, Sitting, Clinic Systolic Blood Pressure', time frame 'Baseline and Week 12'. The measurement is the same measurement in the same words; it is not taken at the same time. GRADE indirectness is rated down for it.
POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_21.b_each_trial_has_two_dose_arms_and_this_: Both trials randomise TWO experimental arms -- azilsartan/chlorthalidone 20-40mg and 40-80mg -- against ONE olmesartan/hydrochlorothiazide comparator. This object stores ONE effect per trial. WHICH DOSE CONTRAST IT REPRESENTS, OR WHETHER THE TWO WERE COMBINED, IS NOT ESTABLISHED from the registrations. Recorded as unestablished rather than assumed, because a multi-arm trial contributing one row against a shared control is where control-group double counting arises.
POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_21.c_the_effect_does_not_survive_the_small_: The unadjusted interval is MD -5.6912 (-7.2996 to -4.0828) mmHg and EXCLUDES no effect. This project's floored Hartung-Knapp interval at k = 2 is -16.1181 to 4.7357 and INCLUDES it. THE HONEST READING IS NARROW: at k = 2 the t critical value is 12.7062 and almost nothing survives, so this is weaker evidence against the result than the same crossing would be at larger k. Disclosed because a reader is entitled to both intervals.
POOL_FINDINGS_2026_08_21.d_risk_of_bias_has_not_been_assessed_on_: STATED PLAINLY. No result-level RoB 2 assessment has been performed for either contributing result. That is recorded as UNASSESSED, never as absent of bias, and GRADE is rated down one level for it. What would close it: RoB 2 per result on the clinic systolic pressure outcome in both registrations.

withholding_question.answer: YES FOR THE TWO INCLUDED TRIALS AND NO FOR THE OTHER TWO. Four registrations in the whole azilsartan programme carry both arms of this contrast. Two register a blood-pressure change outcome and are pooled; two register none at any rank and are ELIGIBLE, NOT POOLABLE. Both of those are long-term open-label SAFETY studies -- n=837 and n=153 -- and their absence from the pool is an estimand fact, not a population one.
withholding_question.why_before_deciding: Asked at EVERY registered rank and detected STRUCTURALLY -- a blood-pressure term plus a change term -- rather than by the two incumbents' registered phrase, which would have found the two that already agree and nothing else.

screening_of_remainder.and_the_included_set_did_not_change: k stays 2. THAT IS A RESULT OF THE SEARCH AND NOT AN ASSUMPTION IT STARTED FROM. Before 2026-08-19 this review had no executed search, so its two trials were the two somebody put on a page; they are now the two the whole 57-record programme supports.

the_two_that_share_both_arms_and_cannot_.NCT00996281: n=837, open-label, long-term safety and tolerability of AZL-CLD against OLM-HCTZ. TWO registered outcomes, neither a blood-pressure change.
the_two_that_share_both_arms_and_cannot_.NCT01309828: n=153, long-term safety of AZL-CLD against OLM-HCTZ in hypertensive subjects with moderate renal impairment. FOUR registered outcomes, none a blood-pressure change. Its coded condition is `Safety`, and reading that field literally would have excluded it on POPULATION -- a different and weaker statement than the true one, which is that it measured something else.

steps.reason: THE RISK-OF-BIAS LIMB IS REFUSED ON THIS OBJECT, and its refusal names its own consequence: 'GRADE rates down one level for risk of bias.' No result-level RoB 2 assessment has been performed for either contributing result, and the refusal records that as UNASSESSED, never as absent of bias. THE DOWNGRADE IS FOR WHAT WE HAVE NOT DONE, not for anything shown about these trials -- both register QUADRUPLE masking including the outcomes assessor, which is the strongest masking either could record.

tau-squared is EXACTLY ZERO, Q 0.2375 on 1 df, p = 0.6260, I-squared 0.00%. The two effects -- -6.1 (-8.4 to -3.8) and -5.3 (-7.6 to -3.1) mmHg -- agree in size and in direction. Downgrading here would manufacture a caution the numbers do not support.

THE POOLED OUTCOME IS CALLED WEEK 8 AND ONE OF ITS TWO TRIALS REGISTERS ITS PRIMARY AT WEEK 12. NCT00846365's registered time frame is 'Baseline and Week 8'; NCT01033071's is 'Baseline and Week 12'. The measurement is identical in words -- trough, sitting, clinic systolic blood pressure -- but an antihypertensive effect at eight weeks and at twelve weeks are not the same quantity, and the outcome's own identifier asserts week 8 for both. RECORDED AND NOT SEPARATELY RATED: both trials randomise TWO experimental dose arms against ONE comparator and this object stores one effect per trial; which dose contrast that is, or whether the two were combined, is not established from the registrations.

steps.move: LOW to VERY LOW -- WARRANTED AND NOT APPLIED, see reason
steps.reason: k = 2. This project's floored Hartung-Knapp interval is -16.1181 to 4.7357 on t = 12.7062 with 1 degree of freedom AND IT INCLUDES NO EFFECT, where the unadjusted interval -7.2996 to -4.0828 excludes it. A downgrade is warranted on that alone. IT IS NOT APPLIED, and the reason is stated rather than hidden: at k = 2 the t critical value is 12.7062 and almost nothing survives the adjustment, so the crossing is weak evidence of imprecision in either direction. NOTE ALSO WHAT IS NOT USED: metafor's RAW unfloored interval here is -10.7725 to -0.6100 and DOES exclude no effect. That is not this project's interval and it is not cited as one.
k = 2. A funnel plot and its asymmetry tests have essentially no power below about ten trials (Handbook 13.3.5.4), so this is NOT ASSESSABLE rather than 'undetected'.

sbp_change_wk8.summary: LOW certainty. The two trials agree closely and both are quadruple-masked, so the downgrades are NOT for inconsistency or for anything shown about how the trials were run. They are for a risk-of-bias assessment this review has not performed, and for the two trials measuring the same quantity AT DIFFERENT TIMES -- week 8 on one registration and WEEK 12 on the other, under an outcome this object identifies as week 8.
sbp_change_wk8.rating_up_not_applied: No domain is rated UP. Rating up for a large effect, a dose-response gradient or opposing plausible confounding applies to observational evidence; these are randomised trials, which start HIGH.
sbp_change_wk8.risk_of_bias_downgrade_follows_the_objec: The risk-of-bias limb on this object is REFUSED and states its consequence: 'GRADE rates down one level for risk of bias.' That instruction is followed rather than re-derived. The object's refusal is the authority on what its own absence costs.
